ec2.name: EC2
ec2.title: EC2 API Coverage
ec2.seoTitle: Amazon EC2 API Coverage on Spinifex — Spinifex Docs
ec2.description: The Amazon EC2 API operations Spinifex implements, covering instances, EBS volumes, VPC networking, tags, security groups and the rest of the compute surface.

notes.aws-backbone: These report performance across AWS's own global network between its regions and zones.
notes.aws-edge: Carrier gateways route to a telecommunications carrier's 5G network in an AWS Wavelength Zone.
notes.aws-support: Reporting an instance as impaired files a report with AWS support about AWS hardware.
notes.ec2-classic: EC2-Classic is the pre-VPC network AWS retired in 2022. Every instance here is in a VPC.
notes.fpga: FPGA images are built and ingested through AWS's own AFI pipeline for its F1 instances.
notes.id-format: These switched resource IDs between the short and long forms during AWS's 2016 migration, which has long since finished.
notes.marketplace: Product codes belong to AWS Marketplace, which has no equivalent here.
notes.retired-accelerators: Elastic Graphics was retired by AWS, and attached nothing but an AWS-hosted accelerator while it existed.
notes.ri-marketplace: The Reserved Instance Marketplace resells a reservation to another AWS customer, so AWS is the counterparty.
notes.spot-price: On owned hardware there is no spot-to-on-demand price differential, so any figure would be invented.

notes.codecommit: CodeCommit credentials and SSH keys; the service does not exist here.
notes.organizations: AWS Organizations is not offered, so there is no organization to report on.
notes.service-linked-roles: Service-linked roles exist for AWS service principals, which this platform has none of.
notes.signing-certificates: X.509 signing certificates are an EC2-Classic SOAP credential, retired by AWS.

rds.name: RDS
rds.title: RDS API Coverage
rds.seoTitle: Relational Database Service API Coverage — Spinifex Docs
rds.description: The Amazon RDS API operations Spinifex implements, for the managed PostgreSQL and MariaDB engines it offers, covering instances, snapshots and parameters.

notes.option-groups: Option groups configure engine add-ons for engines this platform does not offer, such as Oracle and SQL Server.

s3.name: S3
s3.title: S3 API Coverage
s3.seoTitle: Amazon S3 API Coverage on Spinifex — Spinifex Docs
s3.description: The Amazon S3 API operations Predastore serves on the platform's S3 endpoint, covering buckets, objects, multipart uploads and the policies that guard them.

notes.accelerate: Transfer acceleration routes uploads over AWS edge locations, which an on-premise deployment has none of.
notes.express-one-zone: Sessions authenticate S3 Express One Zone directory buckets, a storage class this platform does not offer.
notes.object-lambda: S3 Object Lambda rewrites a response from a Lambda function, and Lambda is not offered.
notes.request-payment: Requester Pays shifts transfer charges to the caller, which needs AWS billing behind it.
